text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- "I did my duty for our people and our brothers on their national land," King Hussein says of his mediation to help save Hebron talks.
- Record profits for Arab Bank Plc in 1996.
- Jordan's leaders oversee celebrations for national tree day.
- Political circles in Jordan welcome Hebron deal.
- World leaders recognise King Hussein's role in saving the peace and security of the region.
- Planning Minister Rima Khalaf announces project to check competitiveness of Jordanian economy.
- Crown Prince Hassan meets Foreign Minister of Luxembourg.
- Jordanian ministers leave for Baghdad for talks on oil supplies and trade.
